SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. File & REGISTRY. No. D. 5671 Station 2 Date February 7, 1934）

REPORT

Subject (in full) China Front Line Disabled & Wounded Sanitorium.

Made by D.I. Sih Tse Liang Forwarded by W. Duncan D.S.P.

In March 1933, an office entitled "The Town
Office of the China Front Line Disabled & Wounded Sanitorium"
came into existence at 116 Lloyd Road with one Tsai Kuh Tung
(崔光東) in charge. Although this office claimed to have
a sanitorium at Feng Ling Jao, off Route Ghisi, nothing
definite was achieved with the exception of the organization
of a medical corps consisting of 62 persons who left Shanghai
during May, 1933, en route to the North, carrying with them
boxes of medical supplies contributed by local people.
The last report on the departure of members of this corps
was dated May 27, 1933 since when nothing has come to notice.
This so-called "Town Office" closed at the end of June,
according to the Tenant of 116 Lloyd Road, after leaving
behind a debt of some $500.00 consisting of rentals, food
and coolies' wages. Tsai Kuh Tung is a northerner, age
about 30.

According to the Red Cross Association
Authorities the Sanitorium is non-existent at present nor
has anything been heard of any attempt being made by local
legal organizations to resuscitate this body.

Sih Tse Liang
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 C. 档案及注册科。编号 D. 5671 第 2 巡捕房 日期 1934 年 2 月 7 日）

报告

事由（全称）中国前线伤残官兵疗养院。

呈报人：特别支部督察长 Sih Tse Liang 转呈人：副警务处长 W. Duncan

1933 年 3 月，一个名为“中国前线伤残官兵疗养院市区办事处”的机构在劳合路（Lloyd Road）116 号成立，由崔光東（Tsai Kuh Tung）负责。尽管该办事处声称在吉司路（Route Ghisi）附近的 Feng Ling Jao 设有一所疗养院，但除组织了一支由 62 人组成的医疗队外，并无其他确切成果；该医疗队于 1933 年 5 月携带本地人士捐赠的箱装医疗物资离开上海北上。关于该医疗队成员出发的最后一份报告日期为 1933 年 5 月 27 日，此后未再获悉任何消息。据劳合路 116 号的租户称，这个所谓的“市区办事处”于 6 月底关闭，留下了约 500.00 美元的债务，包括租金、伙食费和苦力工资。崔光東系北方人，年龄约 30 岁。

据红十字会当局称，该疗养院目前并不存在，亦未闻有任何本地合法组织试图恢复该机构的活动。

Sih Tse Liang
督察长

特别支部主管警官。
